This method returns a list of enabled outbound campaigns, their current states, and unique identifiers. Based on the user privileges configured, the list will contain all campaigns or only those assigned to this user (see here). An empty list will be returned if no outbound campaign is currently enabled or the user has no assigned campaigns.

Note: A campaign's unique identifier returned in the response body can be used to reference that campaign in the path variables of further API requests.

This method creates a copy of the specified campaign.

Note: This method is not supported for Outbound Messaging campaigns.

The new campaign is always created disabled and in the STOPPED state.

Calling lists are not inherited.

Disposition IDs are newly generated, while disposition names and all other settings are inherited.

Settings, dialing mode, teams, roles, caller ids, and calling hours are also inherited from the original campaign.
